# three.js 0.170.0 (vendored)

`three.module.min.js` is the unmodified ES module build from the npm package
`three@0.170.0` (`build/three.module.min.js`, MIT — see `LICENSE`). It imports
nothing. The robot timeline demo uses it for its 3D cobot view.

To update: `npm pack three@<version>`, copy `package/build/three.module.min.js`
and `package/LICENSE` here, and rename this folder. (From r171 the module build
imports `three.core.js`: copy that file too.)
